brass_key: Warm from the clock's works. Too small for any door.
iron_key: Plain and heavy. The bow is stamped with a drawer pull.
matches: Lucifers, half the box gone. Wren never smoked.
photo: Wren at his bookshelf, mid-reach. One book lies flat, one is half drawn, his fingers are on a third.
ring: Wren's ring. The bezel is cut with a W, worn smooth by a thumb.
door_key: Black iron. Cold in a way metal shouldn't be.
lens: A ground lens of green glass in a brass collar. Things look truer through it. Or less true.

lens_element.say: The disc seats behind Wren's Lens with a click. Through the two together, solid things go thin.

chain_key: A tiny key on a ribbon, marked with the library's seal.
seal_stone: A five-sided stone, warm, faintly humming. It fits the cabinet. You know this the way you know your own name.
locker_key: A stubby key on a loop of tarred line. It smells of lamp oil.
crank: An iron crank with a square socket, worn bright where a hand has turned it for forty years.
oil_can: A long-spouted can of lamp oil, still half full.
lantern: A keeper's lantern. The flame doesn't gutter, even in the wind.
keeper_key: A heavy key on a tag: HATCH. Someone scratched under it: DON'T.
chest_key: An iron key cast in the shape of a crab. The legs are the teeth.
seal_stone2: A stone like the first, cold and wet. It smells of the deep sea, and of lamp smoke.
watch: Stopped at twenty past ten. Engraved on the back: OUR HOUR. H.W.
wire: A length of spring steel worked loose from the cot. Ada's fingers wore it bright.

reshape.label: Bend it
reshape.say: You bend the end over into a hook.

wire_hook: The bedspring wire, bent into a hook.

reshape.label: Bend it again
reshape.say: You straighten the hook and work the wire into a zigzag.

wire_zigzag: The bedspring wire, bent back and forth like a lightning stroke.

reshape.label: Straighten it
reshape.say: You straighten the wire out again.

key_bow: The round end of a small brass key, snapped off clean. The break has a tiny notch.

key_blade.say: The two halves click together. The notch holds them like a hinge.

key_blade: The toothed end of a small brass key. The break has a tiny tongue.
sew_key: A small brass key, two halves joined at the break.
locket: A brass locket, heavier than it should be. It doesn't open like a locket.

reshape.label: Pull it apart
reshape.say: The locket comes apart in your hands. The halves fold flat into a square tile with an eye on it.
journal:
Inside Ada Merrow's locket, before it folded into a tile, there was a photograph. It was not of Ada. It was a man in his forties with my jaw and my bad eye, in a sanitarium gown.

The photograph was dated 1911.

tile: A square tile folded out of Ada's locket. An eye, inlaid in green enamel.
punch_card: A tabulator card from Ada's file, punched with six holes in no pattern you can see.
lockbox_key: A steel key with a paper tag: PATIENT EFFECTS.
seal_stone3: A stone like the others, chalky and dry, with two straight lines across it like the bars of a cell.
shears: Nahum Gardner's shears. The blades are furred grey where they've cut the roots.
seeds: A twist of paper with three grey beans in it. Abby Gardner's hand: FOR THE TIN.
pod_key: A green bean pod, curved and hard as horn. It is exactly the shape of a keyhole you've seen.
handle: An iron crank handle with a wooden grip, for the well.
back_key: A grey iron key, cold and faintly greasy.
lens_element: A disc of ground green glass, cut to fit behind another lens. Wren's mark is scratched on the rim.

lens.say: The disc seats behind Wren's Lens with a click. Through the two together, solid things go thin.
journal: Wren's ground disc fits behind his Lens. Through both together I can see into wood and stone, the way you see into shallow water.

lens2: Two green lenses, one behind the other. Through them, solid things go thin.

dream_glass.say: The dream glass slides in behind the other two. Through all three, the room is the room again: messy, cold, and you asleep in it.
journal: The third glass. Through Wren's Lens with all three discs I see what the dream is covering: the study as it really is. Wren called it dream sight. The tidy room is the lie.

seal_stone4: A grey stone with a speck of colour at its heart that has no name.
frozen_tin: A specimen tin frozen into a block of ice. Something rattles inside when you shake it.
thawed_tin: The specimen tin, wet and thawed. The lid is rusted down.

reshape.label: Pry it open
reshape.say: The lid gives. Inside: a flute carved from a long bone, and a scrap of music.
journal: A scrap of manuscript wrapped round the bone flute, in pencil, for the chimes in the shaft: 3, 1, 5, 2, and then the paper is torn. Under it, in another hand: "Don't trust the paper. Trust what answers."

bone_flute: A flute carved from a long, light bone. Not a bird's. It is cold in a way that doesn't warm up.
seal_stone5: A pale stone, cold to the core, with a five-pointed star cut into it.
weight1: A little bronze weight stamped with one dot.
weight3: A bronze weight stamped with a single bar.
weight9: A heavy bronze weight stamped with three bars. Three bars, nine of the small ones: you checked.
seal_stone6: A green-black stone, warm as skin, cut with two bars.
slot_eye: Where a tray slot was. It blinks when you aren't looking.
bow: The violist's bow. The hair is dry and bald; it wouldn't make a sound.

rosin.say: You draw the bow across the rosin until the hair is pale with it.

rosin: A cake of amber rosin, worn into a groove.

bow.say: You draw the bow across the rosin until the hair is pale with it.

rosined_bow: The bow, chalky with rosin. Ready to play.
vane_cock: The iron cock from a weathervane, wrenched off its spindle. It is pointing somewhere even in your hand.
seal_stone7: A violet stone. When you hold it to your ear you hear the street.
dream_glass: A disc of violet glass, soft as a soap bubble and not breaking. It fits behind Wren's Lens.

lens2.say: The dream glass slides in behind the other two. Through all three, the room is the room again: messy, cold, and you asleep in it.
journal: The third glass. Through Wren's Lens with all three discs I see what the dream is covering: the study as it really is. Wren called it dream sight. The tidy room is the lie.

lens3: Wren's Lens with three discs behind it. Dream sight: through it, the dream drops away.
candle: A stub of candle from the dream cabinet. Five notch marks are scratched down its side, for cutting.
seal_stone8: A dark stone with a pale eye in it that closes when you look at it.
